pl-l2d27c1-d1e108.summary: Asks whether the operating, prevenient grace that frees and prepares the will and the cooperating, subsequent grace that helps it are one gift or two.

pl-l2d27c1-d1e111.summary: Reports the reasonable view that it is one grace, gift, and virtue, called operating insofar as it frees and prepares the will to will good, and cooperating insofar as it helps the will to do good work; grace is not idle but merits increase, and when increased, perfection.
claims: One grace is named operating and cooperating by its effects.

pl-l2d27c1.summary: Asks whether operating and cooperating grace are one and the same gift or two. Some reasonably hold it is one grace, one gift, one virtue, called operating insofar as it frees and prepares the will to will good, and cooperating insofar as it helps the will not to will in vain, that is, to do good work; this grace is not idle but merits increase, and when increased, perfection.
claims: Operating and cooperating grace may be one gift named by different effects.
Grace is operating insofar as it frees and prepares the will.
Grace is cooperating insofar as it helps the will to do good.
Grace merits its own increase and perfection.
